title: Haptic Handwheel
idiom: a sunburst archtop guitar with a turntable platter where the pickups would be, hand-pulled screenprint in flat inks; icon as a bold linocut handwheel with a crank knob over vibration lines
hero_prompt: Hand-pulled screenprint on cream paper in four flat inks, slight misregistration, visible paper grain, flat and graphic, hand-made, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no gradients: a wide close view across the top of a vintage electric guitar body, its sunburst finish drawn as two flat bands, amber in the middle and tobacco brown at the edge, and in place of pickups one very large round black handwheel with a thick smooth rim, four stout spokes and a pale cream hub, filling the left third of the frame. A single pale steel string runs from the rim of the wheel straight across the body to the right edge of the frame, and in the middle the string is pulled sideways into a shallow bend, with two thin echo lines beside it to show it vibrating. One small round ruby-red jewel lamp near the wheel. Nothing else on the body: no other knobs, no switches, no plates. Flat inks only: black, cream, amber, tobacco brown and one spot of ruby red.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm amber ground, no shading or gradients: a big round handwheel seen straight on, a thick plain ring with a perfectly smooth outer edge and no teeth, four stout spokes in a cross meeting at a solid round hub, and one small round crank knob sitting on the rim at the upper right. Below the wheel, one thick black wavy line like a vibrating string runs the full width of the square. Nothing else. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
